input.table.yaml:
canonical_name: providers
description: Individual clinicians who deliver care, each employed by an
  organization.
primary_key:
  - Id
relationships:
  foreign_keys:
    - column: ORGANIZATION
      cross_pipeline: false
      references_column: Id
      references_table: organizations
      type: foreign_key
table_name: providers
table_type: ingested
version: '1.0'
input.columns/GENDER.yaml:
column:
  data_type: VARCHAR
  description: Provider's gender. M is male, F is female.
  exclude_from_change_detection: false
  length: 1
  name: GENDER
  preserve_literal_null: false
  sample_values:
    - M
    - F
  source: data
input.columns/Id.yaml:
column:
  data_type: VARCHAR
  description: Primary key. Unique provider identifier (UUID).
  exclude_from_change_detection: false
  length: 36
  name: Id
  preserve_literal_null: false
  source: data
input.columns/NAME.yaml:
column:
  data_type: VARCHAR
  description: Provider's full name.
  exclude_from_change_detection: false
  length: 200
  name: NAME
  preserve_literal_null: false
  sample_values:
    - Dr. Alice Nguyen
  source: data
input.columns/ORGANIZATION.yaml:
column:
  data_type: VARCHAR
  description: Foreign key to the Organization that employs this 
    provider.
  exclude_from_change_detection: false
  length: 36
  name: ORGANIZATION
  preserve_literal_null: false
  source: data
input.columns/SPECIALITY.yaml:
column:
  data_type: VARCHAR
  description: Provider's clinical specialty.
  exclude_from_change_detection: false
  length: 100
  name: SPECIALITY
  preserve_literal_null: false
  sample_values:
    - GENERAL PRACTICE
    - CARDIOLOGY
  source: data
